```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(car)
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(readxl)


```


```{r}
# Load dataset (adjust file path as necessary)
dataset <- read_excel("Dataset.xlsx")
glimpse(dataset)  # Check the structure of the dataset
summary(dataset)  # Summary statistics
```

## Data Preprocessing

```{r}
# Select relevant columns for analysis
selected_features <- dataset %>%
    dplyr::select(overall, pace, shooting, passing, dribbling, defending, physic,
                  attacking_finishing, skill_moves, skill_dribbling, movement_acceleration, 
                  power_shot_power, mentality_aggression, mentality_vision, 
                  defending_marking_awareness, age, height_cm, weight_kg)

# Check for missing values in selected features
colSums(is.na(selected_features))

# Handle missing values by removing rows with any missing values
selected_features <- selected_features %>% drop_na()

```

## Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)


```{r}
# Correlation Matrix for selected features
cor_matrix <- cor(selected_features %>% dplyr::select(-overall), use = "complete.obs")
corrplot::corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "circle")

# Scatter plot matrix for key features against the target variable (overall rating)
pairs(selected_features %>% dplyr::select(overall, pace, dribbling, defending, passing, shooting, skill_moves, movement_acceleration))

```


# Model Building


## Multiple Linear Regression


```{r}
# Multiple Linear Regression Model with a broader set of attributes
model_lm <- lm(overall ~ pace + shooting + passing + dribbling + defending + physic +
               attacking_finishing + skill_moves + skill_dribbling + movement_acceleration +
               power_shot_power + mentality_aggression + mentality_vision + 
               defending_marking_awareness + age + height_cm + weight_kg, data = selected_features)
summary(model_lm)

# Check for multicollinearity using VIF
vif_values <- car::vif(model_lm)
vif_values

```

## Interaction and Second-Order Terms

```{r}
# Adding interaction and quadratic terms for highly correlated features
model_interaction <- lm(overall ~ pace * dribbling + shooting * passing + 
                        I(pace^2) + I(dribbling^2) + I(shooting^2) + I(passing^2) + 
                        defending + physic + attacking_finishing + skill_moves + 
                        skill_dribbling + movement_acceleration + power_shot_power +
                        mentality_aggression + mentality_vision + age + height_cm + weight_kg, 
                        data = selected_features)
summary(model_interaction)

```


## Regularized Regression (Ridge and Lasso)

```{r}
# Convert data to matrix format for glmnet
# Ensure that the 'overall' column is included in 'selected_features'
x <- model.matrix(overall ~ ., data = selected_features)
y <- selected_features$overall

# Lasso Regression
lasso_model <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1)  # Fit the Lasso model
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1)  # Perform cross-validation for Lasso
plot(cv_lasso)  # Plot cross-validation results for Lasso

# Extract the optimal lambda for Lasso
lasso_best_lambda <- cv_lasso$lambda.min
cat("Optimal lambda for Lasso:", lasso_best_lambda, "\n")

# Coefficients for Lasso at the best lambda
lasso_coef <- predict(lasso_model, s = lasso_best_lambda, type = "coefficients")
print("Coefficients for Lasso Regression:")
print(lasso_coef)

# Ridge Regression
ridge_model <- glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0)  # Fit the Ridge model
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0)  # Perform cross-validation for Ridge
plot(cv_ridge)  # Plot cross-validation results for Ridge

# Extract the optimal lambda for Ridge
ridge_best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
cat("Optimal lambda for Ridge:", ridge_best_lambda, "\n")

# Coefficients for Ridge at the best lambda
ridge_coef <- predict(ridge_model, s = ridge_best_lambda, type = "coefficients")
print("Coefficients for Ridge Regression:")
print(ridge_coef)

```


## Model Evaluation



```{r}
# Cross-validation for Multiple Linear Regression
set.seed(123)
train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
model_cv_lm <- train(overall ~ pace + shooting + passing + dribbling + defending + physic +
                     attacking_finishing + skill_moves + skill_dribbling + movement_acceleration +
                     power_shot_power + mentality_aggression + mentality_vision + 
                     defending_marking_awareness + age + height_cm + weight_kg, 
                     data = selected_features, method = "lm", trControl = train_control)
print(model_cv_lm)

# Cross-validation for Interaction Model
model_cv_interaction <- train(overall ~ pace * dribbling + shooting * passing + 
                              I(pace^2) + I(dribbling^2) + I(shooting^2) + I(passing^2) + 
                              defending + physic + attacking_finishing + skill_moves + 
                              skill_dribbling + movement_acceleration + power_shot_power +
                              mentality_aggression + mentality_vision + age + height_cm + weight_kg, 
                              data = selected_features, method = "lm", trControl = train_control)
print(model_cv_interaction)

# Cross-validation error for Lasso
lasso_best_lambda_cv <- cv_lasso$lambda.min
lasso_mse <- cv_lasso$cvm[cv_lasso$lambda == lasso_best_lambda_cv]
cat("Lasso Cross-Validation MSE:", lasso_mse, "\n")

# Cross-validation error for Ridge
ridge_best_lambda_cv <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
ridge_mse <- cv_ridge$cvm[cv_ridge$lambda == ridge_best_lambda_cv]
cat("Ridge Cross-Validation MSE:", ridge_mse, "\n")

```


## Residual Analysis and Diagnostics


```{r}
# Residual diagnostics for Multiple Linear Regression model
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  # Set up a 2x2 plotting space
plot(model_lm)

# Normal Q-Q Plot for residuals of Interaction Model
qqnorm(model_interaction$residuals)
qqline(model_interaction$residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Residual diagnostics for Ridge Regression
ridge_residuals <- y - predict(ridge_model, s = ridge_best_lambda, newx = x)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
plot(ridge_residuals, main = "Residual Plot for Ridge Regression", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# Residual diagnostics for Lasso Regression
lasso_residuals <- y - predict(lasso_model, s = lasso_best_lambda, newx = x)
plot(lasso_residuals, main = "Residual Plot for Lasso Regression", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

```

## Feature Importance

```{r}
# Feature importance plot for Multiple Linear Regression
broom::tidy(model_lm) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(statistic))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(reorder(term, abs(statistic)), abs(statistic))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "Features", y = "Importance (absolute t-value)", title = "Feature Importance")

```
